newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Cosmos buys bottling plants.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Cosmos buys bottling plants.

text.p: Cosmos Bottling Corp, the beverage unit of RFM Corp, has acquired additional bottling plants in the central Philippines to help strengthen its competitive position, the company said on Sunday.
Cosmos said in a statement it had paid an initial amount of 584 million pesos for Jaz and RC Cola bottling plants and that the final price would be subject to on-site assessment of the plants.

"This is part of our overall strategy of growing through acquisitions, strategic alliances and brand positioning, and we expect to substantially improve our revenues and market share," RFM Corp president Jose Concepcion III said.
Antonio Panajon, Cosmos executive vice president, said that the acquisitions would add three more bottling plants to Cosmos' eight existing plants nationwide.
"This will effectively boost our distribution strength nationwide and allow us to compete on a more even footing with multinational companies," Panajon said.
